case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption: Gopal v. State of Madhya Pradesh.

number_of_accused.reason: Five accused were charged and their liability is decided in the common appeals.

accused_gender.reason: Gopal is referred to with male pronouns ("he", "his"); co-accused are also male.

accused_age.reason: No age is stated for any accused.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity is described for the accused or their community.

accused_caste.quote: a meeting of a Patidar Community was convened

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: The victim Mitthulal is referred to as male ("his chest").

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated.

victim_caste.quote: called by one Poonamchand to attend the Panchayat of their community
victim_caste.reason: The judgment describes the complainant party as belonging to the community whose panchayat they were called to attend.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity is described for the victim or complainant party.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Both parties are linked through the same community panchayat, supporting an acquaintance description.

offence_category.reason: The final conviction is culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 Part I.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charged sections (147, 148, 149, 302, 323), s.304 Part I and s.324 all appear in the judgment.

weapon.reason: Knife, sword and cycle chain are all described as weapons used.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness account, post-mortem/medical evidence and weapon recovery are all present.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by an accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court notes no aggravating facts.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The court notes no mitigating facts; the free-fight argument was only advanced by counsel.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Convictions under the listed sections for each accused match paragraph 2; fine details are not given.

high_court_outcome.reason: Gopal's s.302 altered to s.304 Part I with 10 years; co-accused s.324 with undergone period; Dinesh acquitted (para 4).

final_outcome.reason: Gopal's conviction was altered to a lesser offence and sentence reduced, matching conviction_modified.

offence_finally_established.reason: Gopal's s.304 Part I conviction was upheld and the State's appeal against the s.324 convictions was dismissed.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence is a term of imprisonment equal to the period undergone, a fixed term.

imprisonment_years.quote: which is more than six years
imprisonment_years.reason: Judgment gives only 'more than six years' as the period undergone, not an exact figure; null is not right for a fixed term.

fine_rs.reason: No fine for Gopal's final sentence is stated, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.reason: Neutral prosecution summary with no names or outcomes; it omits the defence version but stays within the evidence described.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range for the offences.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Fatal stab wound, liver injury, simple injuries to complainant party and unexplained accused injuries are all described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 5 charged (ss.147, 148, 149, 302, 323); 1 finally upheld (Gopal, s.304 Part I)
number_of_offences.reason: Charged count is right, but the final count mixes in co-accused s.324 convictions that are not Gopal's offences.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is found or discussed.

motive.reason: No motive is identified; the dispute is only described as a panchayat meeting that did not take place.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Post-mortem evidence, PW-5's simple-injury evidence and the unexplained-injury finding are the points the court relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: The court does not assess witness credibility in detail and relies on medical evidence, as stated.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is noted.

custody_duration.reason: The court states the period undergone is more than six years.

investigation_status.reason: Report, spot map, arrests, weapon recovery, post-mortem, charge-sheet and trial with 13 witnesses are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The court notes no procedural irregularity.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the State's arguments in paragraph 16.
